summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a reST docstring, and added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering rules 1–2 counts, typed/untyped reifiers (8 and 13 triples), incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node non-expansion in reification, blank-node cycles, and source-graph immutability. Nothing was run or committed, per instructions. Expected counts are hand-derived from my own fixtures, not confirmed by test execution; running the unittest module and flake8 would verify them.
